messages:
anya: Quick sync Quokka Insights case study  interview set Thu Jul 10 11:00am PT. Deliverables: launch post, 30s testimonial, 15s social clip, product page quote. Need quote + logo license by Tues Jul 8 EOD.

mri: I'll own recording and clips. Can someone confirm whether Quokka wants an embargo? They mentioned a partner announcement window.

ben: Draft quote to propose (please edit):
```
"Redwood let us deliver live insights to customers without reworking our inference stack."  Naomi T., VP Product, Quokka Insights
```
Keep it short; avoid specific $$ or token language.

sam: PR: I'll send the quote + logo request to Naomi and ask specifically for an "approved for public release" line if they share metrics. Also ask whether they'd co-host a follow-up webinar.

legal-bot: Note: any numeric metric requires written permission with signer and date. Request SVG logo and a short permission line: "Approved for public release by Quokka Insights, [date]". Route files to legal@redwood.example for audit.

anya: Headline options for team reaction (react with :one: or :two:):
1) Product: "Quokka Insights adds live analytics with Redwood Inference"
2) Outcome: "Quokka Insights ships live analytics without heavy infra work"
Which tone we want?

mri: Also will capture a 4K speaker frame for hero. Editors want chapter marks (intro, metrics, product flow, closing) so clips are faster.

ben: If they provide a percent improvement, we'll add it to a benchmark sidebar. Legal must confirm.

sam: Template outreach I'm sending: > Hi Naomi thanks for agreeing to talk. Can you confirm the quote below, attach SVG logo if available, and let us know if theres any metric you want published (with exact wording and signer line)? Also, would you be open to co-hosting a short webinar after launch? Please reply by Tue Jul 8 EOD so we can keep timeline.

ops: Calendar event created: "Quokka Insights  Case Study Interview" Thu Jul 10 11:00am PT  Recording: https://meet.redwood.example/quokka-9876. Zap: will tag inbound leads with case_quokka_launch if live.

legal-bot: Reminder: collect explicit approval before publishing metrics. If they request edits, route redlines to legal@redwood.example and cc PR.

mri: Sent DM to Naomi. Will paste reply here. Editors: I'll upload raw + chapters to /shared/marketing/quokka after call.

(2h later)

sam: Naomi replied: "Quote approved as-is. Attaching SVG. We can publish a 9% improvement in throughput; legal approves the line 'Approved for public release by Quokka Insights, Jul 11 2026.' Please embargo publish until Jul 18 to align with partner window." Link to SVG uploaded to drive.

legal-bot: Received approval line. Legal sign-off logged. Ensure footer in post: "Approved for public release by Quokka Insights, Jul 11 2026."

anya: Great  timeline recap:
- Tue Jul 8 EOD: customer permission + logo (done)
- Thu Jul 10: interview + capture (mri)
- Mon Jul 13: draft post + clips (ben/mri)
- Wed Jul 15: internal review (sam/anya/legal)
- Thu Jul 18: embargoed publish (ops schedule)

ben: Editors note: include the 9% throughput stat in the benchmark sidebar and timestamp where Naomi mentions it in the recording. Create 15s/30s/60s cuts.

ops: Will schedule embargoed CMS publish for Jul 18 and enable zap tags case_quokka_launch + webinar_interest at publish. Provide SFDC mapping to PR when ready.

anya: Final actions: Sam -> finalize copy and schedule reviews; Mri -> record + upload clips; Ben -> draft post + benchmark; Legal-bot -> store approval record; Ops -> schedule embargoed publish and lead routing.

sam: On it. Pasting final approved quote to use in post: "Redwood let us deliver live insights to customers without reworking our inference stack."  Naomi T., VP Product, Quokka Insights

mri: Recording checklist done. Will upload within 24h of call.

(End thread  assets + approvals in /shared/marketing/quokka)
